newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Early morning quake shakes Indonesia's N.Sulawesi.
newsitem.headline: Early morning quake shakes Indonesia's N.Sulawesi.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.7 on the Richter scale shook Indonesia's North Sulawesi province early on Thursday, an official from the meteorological and geophysics office said.

The official in the North Sulawesi capital of Manado said there were no immediate reports of damage or injury from the earthquake under the Molucca Sea, about 350 km (217 miles) northeast of the provincial city.
He said the tremor, which struck at 2:38 a.m. (1838 GMT Wednesday), was slightly felt in the nearby towns of Tomohon and Tondano, about 60 km (37 miles) south of Manado.
Earlier the Royal Hong Kong Observatory recorded a strong earthquake estimated at 5.6 on the Richter scale at 2:24 a.m. local time (1824 GMT Wednesday).

The Hong Kong observatory said the earthquake's epicentre was off the north coast of Halmahera, about 250 km (155 miles) north-northeast of Ternate, or about the same location recorded by Indonesian officials.
